ignoreValues.reason: Quoted-reply markers, not card accents: the two left rules are .composerReplyContext (the composer's quoted-reply strip) and .messageReplyPreview (the in-transcript quote block). A left rule is the blockquote convention for a quotation and is the quote indicator itself, not decoration on a card. Both rules are committed in HEAD, predate this work, and sit on approved quoted-reply UI the brief pins as a regression requirement. Scoped to this file so the rule stays live everywhere else.
